candidate.title: MPE-seq
candidate.scope: The single MPE-seq (methidiumpropyl-EDTA sequencing) row of the supplied Illumina poster: chromatin in isolated nuclei → MPE digestion → addition labeled bathophenanthroline → DNA extraction. The endpoint is extracted genomic DNA; library construction and sequencing are unshown. The supplied primary abstract establishes the downstream sequencing interface and fragment-based chromatin readout. Targeted supplemental primary full text and its author correction resolve the depicted addition as a quench and correct the reagent identity, while retaining the diagram label and order. The matching collection page has the MPE-seq heading and caption sequence and is secondary catalogue evidence. The far-left summary icon, neighboring DamID/Chem-seq rows and the abstract’s MNase comparator do not add targets. This record describes the depicted implementation, not every MPE-seq protocol.

states.label: Extracted chromatin-derived DNA fragments
features: Blue DNA lines without gray nucleosomal particles form the depicted endpoint. No adapter, barcode, strand polarity or specific end-group chemistry is shown.

Chromatin-derived genomic DNA is the carrier of the readout, rather than the associated proteins or an RNA-derived product. Downstream libraries made from the digestion products represent genomic fragment patterns caused by differential chromatin protection.

The abstract reports nucleosome-sized and smaller chromatin-fragment peaks; the particle icons therefore do not imply mononucleosome-only recovery or one fixed fragment length. Fragment patterns support chromatin-organization inference, but the DNA-only readout does not directly identify every associated protein.

operations.label: MPE digestion
operations.description: Treat chromatin in isolated nuclei with MPE-Fe(II), cleaving DNA preferentially in the linker regions between nucleosomes and producing digested chromatin. The star-marked panel depicts the digestion stage; separated chromatin fragments become explicit in the following panel.
operations.mechanism: The matched secondary catalogue describes methidium-mediated DNA intercalation and oxygen-dependent generation of single- and double-stranded DNA breaks by MPE-Fe(II). The primary abstract independently establishes nuclear digestion and preferential linker cleavage.
operations.information_effect: Genomic fragment boundaries and sizes encode differential protection of DNA within chromatin. Preferential linker cleavage and the reported limited sequence bias support a chromatin-structure readout, without guaranteeing nucleosome-only specificity or exclusive recovery of active chromatin.
